title: Final Temperature Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expression for T_m in terms of T_u and T_l.

title: Net Flux Density Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should show that the net energy flux density is halved due to the presence of the middle plane.

title: Reflectivity Impact
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate how the presence of reflectivity r modifies the flux density expression.

title: Correct Units
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all quantities are expressed with correct units throughout the solution.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes when setting up the equations for flux balance.
